provenance.source: Algorithm specification v0.2 corrections supplied by the user on 2026-10-21
provenance.referenceImplementation: ref_rules.py and its executable test files have not been supplied or run here
provenance.scope: Newly agreed boundary and zero-handling cases only; not a substitute for Python/Rust/Native/WASM parity tests

units.toWire: Choose one nonnegative Unix-ms origin and convert every tSec to origin + tSec * 1000; convert bucketSec to bucketMs. Preserve the relative event and window positions.
units.metricValues: Decimal strings in scalar cases are hand-specified metric values, not raw reserve encoding. A wire fixture must represent them using integer reserve strings and fixed decimals; do not pass fractional strings as reserves.

cases.initialState: The point at 0 seeds the direction state; the 10-second rise confirms the initial direction but is not a reversal. All required initialization is available.
cases.note: Resolution eligibility is X2 > (m - 1) * delta. It does not assert that eligible data necessarily contains enough events, and it is not a warm-up completeness test.

R1 uses X1 > (n - 1) * delta. X2 >= delta is the agreed MVP minimum supported window for window_drop, not a mathematical impossibility claim about shorter windows. Actual evaluation still requires valid data, capabilities and initial state.
10 -> 0 is a valid -100% event. 0 -> 5 emits no percentage event and seeds fresh positive state; 5 -> 5.5 is a valid +10% event. Zero quote reserve by itself is not missing data.

The zero denominator makes only the price metric unavailable at 10. End the segment, reset its state, and seed a new segment at 20. These assertions do not prescribe a more specific failure reason than the agreed incomplete/missing-data semantics.
The drop to zero confirms the peak. The next positive value seeds new state; the rise to 60 determines a new initial direction, not a cross-zero trough reversal.

reuse.purpose: Reuse the existing maximum-count/latest-end tie expectation. No duplicate executable case or new execution claim is added here.
